intent: Key frame 30 loses its STAP-A of SPS and PPS, never repaired; its IDR arrives whole. The track buffer asks once, 200-240 ms after the IDR reveals the gap. The IDR cannot start decoding without its own parameter sets, so the writer drops frames 30-59 and resumes at key frame 60. RED when an IDR without in-band SPS and PPS counts as a key frame: frames 30-59 are written (90), and key block 30 carries no SPS or PPS.
